description: This file defines functions and types for creating and managing browser instances within the Playwright testing framework, including remote, CDP, isolated, and persistent browsers, as well as utility functions for handling user data directories and port allocation.

methods.name: createBrowser
methods.description: Main function to create a browser instance based on configuration, supporting remote, CDP, isolated, extension, and persistent modes.

methods.name: createIsolatedBrowser
methods.description: Creates an isolated browser instance with specific launch options.

methods.name: createCDPBrowser
methods.description: Creates a browser instance connected over Chrome DevTools Protocol.

methods.name: createRemoteBrowser
methods.description: Connects to a remote browser endpoint, possibly across different versions.

methods.name: createPersistentBrowser
methods.description: Creates a persistent browser instance with user data directory management.

methods.name: createUserDataDir
methods.description: Generates a user data directory path based on client info and environment variables.

methods.name: injectCdpPort
methods.description: Injects a free port into the browser launch options for Chromium.

methods.name: createHash
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash of input data, truncated to 7 characters.

methods.name: computeTracesDir
methods.description: Computes the directory path for storing traces.

methods.name: isProfileLocked5Times
methods.description: Checks if a user data profile is locked, retrying up to 5 times.

methods.name: isProfileLocked
methods.description: Determines if a user data profile is currently locked.

methods.name: throwBrowserIsNotInstalledError
methods.description: Throws an error if the required browser is not installed.

methods.name: startServer
methods.description: Registers a session with the browser server if session info is provided.
